meta.name: debugging-playbook
meta.description: Debugging playbook for this project. Use when anything is broken, a test fails, a webhook isn't firing, an AI reply is wrong, or behavior doesn't match expectations, in ANY service. Contains the general investigation workflow plus a list of known gotchas specific to this project's polyglot architecture.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查项目故障，按手册一步步定位根因。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在维护这个多语言项目，经常遇到测试失败或行为不符预期。
copy.tagline_en: Troubleshoot any project failure with a step-by-step debugging checklist.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain this polyglot project and often debug failures.

howto.what: 装上后，当项目出问题时，Claude会按调试手册一步步排查：先查AI网关日志，再定位出错的服务，检查服务间通信，最后修复根本原因并验证；同时会对照一份项目常见问题清单逐项检查。
howto.when: 当项目出现故障时触发，例如测试失败、AI回复错误、Webhook没触发，或任何行为不符合预期。

say.text: 测试又失败了，按调试手册帮我查一下原因。
say.note: Claude会从复现问题开始，按步骤排查。

say.text: AI回复内容不对，先看看AI网关日志怎么说。
say.note: 它会把网关日志当作首要排查依据。

say.text: Webhook显示200但没反应，帮我查一下已知问题。
say.note: 它会对照Meta webhook等常见陷阱清单检查。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when a project issue occurs, Claude follows the debugging playbook: check AI gateway logs first, locate the failing service, verify service communication, fix the root cause, and verify; it also checks a list of known project-specific gotchas.
howto.when_en: Triggers when something is broken — e.g., a test fails, an AI reply is wrong, a webhook isn't firing, or behavior doesn't match expectations in any service.

say_en.text: Tests are failing again — walk me through the playbook.
say_en.note: Claude starts by reproducing and steps through the workflow.

say_en.text: The AI reply is wrong — check the AI gateway logs first.
say_en.note: It treats gateway logs as the single source of truth.

say_en.text: Webhook returns 200 but nothing happens — check known gotchas.
say_en.note: It reviews project-specific issues like the Meta webhook trap.
